item.title: UK house prices fall at steepest rate in more than three years
item.body: Lloyds says the average UK property price was £296,285 in October, after a 0.6% drop. It was the fourth consecutive monthly decline, as high mortgage rates hit the housing market.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📉 UK house prices fall at steepest rate in more than three years

Lloyds says the average UK property price was £296,285 in October, after a 0.6% drop. It was the fourth consecutive monthly decline, as high mortgage rates hit the housing market.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 6 November, 08:50
